text: 金十数据9月4日讯，康欣新材公告，公司于2026年9月4日收到证监会《立案告知书》，因定期报告涉嫌信息披露违法违规，证监会决定对公司立案。目前公司各项经营活动正常开展，将积极配合调查并履行信息披露义务。
text_en: Jin Shi Data September 4 - Kangxin New Materials announced that the company received a 'Case Filing Notice' from the CSRC on September 4, 2026. Due to suspected information disclosure violations in periodic reports, the CSRC decided to file a case against the company. Currently, all business operations are proceeding normally, and the company will actively cooperate with the investigation and fulfill information disclosure obligations.
